description: This file implements the Timer class, which manages a timer thread with start, cancel, and callback functionalities. It uses pthreads for thread and synchronization management, and integrates with GStreamer for debugging. The class provides mechanisms to arm, cancel, and handle timer expirations via message passing.

classes.name: Timer
classes.description: A class that manages a timer thread, allowing arming, canceling, and executing callbacks upon timer expiry.

methods.name: Timer::timerThread
methods.description: Main loop of the timer thread, handling message queue and timer expiration.

methods.name: Timer::postTimerMessage
methods.description: Posts a message to the timer thread's message queue, either urgent or normal.
